self_audit: Read prd.md (lines 1-521) in four ranges and addendum.md in full. Checked grammar, run-on and mixed lists, ambiguous antecedents, undefined abbreviations, inconsistent terms and numbering. Skipped frontmatter, id columns, backtick spans, quoted source text (issue 409, SPEC.md, release-gates.md, owner-decisions-and-risks.md risk table K1-K12, which is stated as verbatim), OQ-1 to OQ-15 text, evidence labels and ids. addendum.md had no issues beyond the back-off spelling, which is fixed on the prd.md side. Other undefined shorthand (AC-S, M:n, A-008, QUALIFY) was left alone because it appears to be spec-carried and the meaning could not be confirmed from these two files.
